Coconut
Family Arecaceae or Palmaceae
Scientific name Cocos nucifera
Common name coconut
♥High in saturated fat
fruit when it is about 7 years old.  The
fruits are produced in clusters near the
base of the leaf fronds at the rate of about
50 per year.  Thus, during its lifetime of
70 to 100 years, the coconut palm
produces thousands of fruits.  Fresh
coconuts are available year-round, with
the peak season from October through
December.  Coconuts that are available
for sale in the United States almost always
have the two outer layers removed.  Upon
ripening, the flesh of the coconut trans-
forms from a translucent yellow gel to a
firm, white meat.
